omitted.asdcontrol: Requires direct ALSA speaker devices; Android owns audio hardware.
omitted.bluez: Requires privileged Bluetooth/HCI device access; Android owns Bluetooth.
omitted.bluez-tools: Controls BlueZ devices unavailable to this unrooted Android session.
omitted.bluez-utils: Controls BlueZ devices unavailable to this unrooted Android session.
omitted.brightnessctl: Requires writable host backlight devices; Android owns brightness.
omitted.kernel-modules-hook: Requires a booted guest kernel and module installation.
omitted.networkmanager: Requires privileged host network-interface control; Android supplies networking.
omitted.plymouth: Controls Linux boot screens; Android owns boot and app entry.
omitted.power-profiles-daemon: Requires privileged host CPU/power controls; Android owns power policy.
omitted.qemu-user-static-binfmt: Registers foreign executables through privileged kernel binfmt_misc.
omitted.sddm: Requires a privileged Linux login/display manager; Android owns app entry.
omitted.udiskie: Requires host block devices and privileged mount operations.
omitted.ufw: Requires privileged host netfilter access; Android owns the firewall.
omitted.uwsm: Requires a systemd user session; Android directly owns the compositor session.
omitted.wireless-regdb: Configures the host Wi-Fi kernel; Android owns Wi-Fi.
omitted.zram-generator: Requires a booted guest kernel, zram devices and privileged swap setup.
